propositions: The autouse _no_repo_commits guard invokes git rev-parse HEAD before and after every test, causing ~26k subprocess launches across the 13255-test suite and projecting ~75s wall-time overhead on macOS.
The current guard must preserve per-test HEAD-move detection, individual test attribution, and the allow_repo_writes escape hatch without weakening repo-isolation semantics.

In-process HEAD fingerprinting after one-time per-worker Git directory discovery can eliminate the per-test subprocess overhead while covering symbolic refs, packed refs, detached HEAD, and linked worktrees.

A survey of pytest, pip, Poetry, and pre-commit shows 4/4 consensus against per-test source-checkout VCS subprocess launches, but no consensus on a fidelity-preserving implementation primitive (Git library dependency, hand-parsing ref formats, or removing per-test attribution).

No production code change was approved; the measured opportunity (~75s macOS wall, ~207 runner-seconds) is retained for operator disposition pending either explicit design choice or new evidence for a safe implementation.
The ticket was force-closed under operator disposition (wontfix) on 2026-08-19 without implementation attestation.
